title: A lure in the dark
hook: A structure can extend beyond a fish’s mouth.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The line and circle highlight a lure extending from the fish’s head region. Some anglerfishes use a modified dorsal-fin structure as a lure; species vary, and the drawing does not show a verified encounter or how the lure produces light.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: In some anglerfishes, what structure is used to attract prey toward the fish?
